title: Ya Muhammad
body:
Ya muhammad..(6)
Ya muhammad aisi izzat aapne paayi ke bus..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ki shabe asraa khuda ne woh paziraai k bus
yaa muhammad
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ek pal me mustafa ko arsh par bulwaaliya
ek pal me mustafa ko apne ghar bulwa liya
<<DIVIDER>>
apne bande ki khuda ko aisi yaad aayi ke bus
2. Ginte ginte thak gayi taaro ki naazuk ungliya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
mustafa ke hai zameen par itne shaydayi k bus
3. Maine jalti dhoop me jab chhed di naate rasool..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
rehmato ki har taraf aisi ghata chhayi k bus
4. Dekh ab bhi waqt hai daaman nabi ka thaam le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
warna kal mehshar me hogi aisi ruswaayi ke bus
5. Ek din mai likhne baitha tha shabe hijrat kaa haal..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahu yaaro mujhe bhi aisi neend aayi k bus
6. Un farishto ne abhi pucha hi kya tha ai saroj..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
daf'atan mere sirhaane se sada aayi ke bus
author: Mir Hassan Mir
